content:
LangGraph for agent reasoning, Airflow 3 for durable schedules, and promotion gates that treat agent changes like software releases.

Enterprise agent programmes fail when teams stop at a framework demo. TenthMatrix’s products hub now calls out the stack we operationalise:

  • LangChain / LangGraph for stateful tool-using agents
  • LangSmith (and OTel siblings) for evals and traces
  • Apache Airflow 3.x for ingest, model refresh, and batch agent jobs
  • MCP OAuth, approval gates, Ring Promoter, and Proxy10x for production survival
